# Write-free e2e: unimplemented profile IDs rejected with exact available set.
# Phase 4 available set is [distribution]; configuration/local-persistence are recipe-only.

# configuration (recipe topic, not a profile).
! exec foundry validate --spec profile-configuration.toml
stderr 'resolve.unknown_profile'
stderr 'available profiles: \[distribution\]'
stderr 'configuration'
assert_error_id stderr resolve.unknown_profile

# local-persistence (recipe topic).
! exec foundry validate --spec profile-local-persistence.toml
stderr 'resolve.unknown_profile'
stderr 'local-persistence'
stderr 'available profiles: \[distribution\]'
assert_error_id stderr resolve.unknown_profile

# typo / invented profile id — exact set only (no fuzzy suggestions).
! exec foundry validate --spec profile-typo.toml
stderr 'resolve.unknown_profile'
stderr 'typo-profile'
stderr 'available profiles: \[distribution\]'
assert_error_id stderr resolve.unknown_profile

# plan path same rejection.
! exec foundry plan --spec profile-configuration.toml
stderr 'resolve.unknown_profile'
assert_error_id stderr resolve.unknown_profile

# JSON form carries error_id + remediation.
! exec foundry validate --spec profile-configuration.toml --output json
stdout 'resolve.unknown_profile'
stdout '"ok":false'
stdout 'remediation'
! stderr .
assert_error_id stdout resolve.unknown_profile

-- profile-configuration.toml --
schema = 1
name = "profile-configuration"
module = "github.com/example/profile-configuration"
description = "Unimplemented profile configuration"
archetype = "cli"
destination = "./profile-configuration"
profiles = ["configuration"]

-- profile-local-persistence.toml --
schema = 1
name = "profile-local-persistence"
module = "github.com/example/profile-local-persistence"
description = "Unimplemented profile local-persistence"
archetype = "cli"
destination = "./profile-local-persistence"
profiles = ["local-persistence"]

-- profile-typo.toml --
schema = 1
name = "profile-typo"
module = "github.com/example/profile-typo"
description = "Invented profile id typo"
archetype = "cli"
destination = "./profile-typo"
profiles = ["typo-profile"]
